verdict.rationale: Martin's documented actions all run through connected cloud integrations: calendar, inbox, Slack, to-dos, notes and reminders. Nothing in the evidence shows it seeing the screen or operating local desktop applications. The community mention of 'Martin desktop' describes a side-by-side app for managing to-dos, not computer control, so integration-based actions are adjacent and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
